title: Good squat
description: Three controlled reps after a calm start.

title: Feet cut off
description: The camera is too low or too close; the feet leave the image.

title: Someone walks in
description: A second person enters the frame halfway through.

title: Turned away
description: The front test is done turned about 40 degrees away from the camera.

title: Tracker glitches
description: The left knee jumps in some frames, like a tracking failure.

title: No calm start
description: Squatting starts immediately, with no standing baseline.

title: Too shallow
description: Reps stop at about 45 degrees of knee flexion.

title: Heels lift
description: Heels come about 5 cm off the floor at the bottom.

title: Too fast
description: Each rep takes well under a second.
